Who's installing the software on our computers?
A. Some accounting software.
B. There was an email about that.
C. It was an extra monitor.
context.transcript_translation:
谁正在我们的电脑上安装软件？
A. 一些会计软件。
B. 有一封关于那件事的电子邮件。
C. 这是一个额外的显示器。

choices: There was an email about that.
items.question: Who's installing the software on our computers?
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：问句或陈述是“Who's installing the software on our computers?”，自然应答是“There was an email about that.”。选择理由：该项在语义和会话功能上直接承接前句；其余选项只是词汇相关、时态不合或答非所问。正确答案：B（There was an email about that.）。
